document: Founder and CTO at Collaplan (January 2014 - January 2024). Collaplan is a collaborative urban planning platform connecting officials, companies, and residents. Built Laravel Lumen backend APIs and React web clients. Managed MySQL databases and integrated Google Maps for geospatial features. Contributed to visualization tools with Unity 3D and C#. Used Docker for development and deployment workflows.
